from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single cash balance entry found within a document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item text as written in the balance sheet")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions'")
    balance_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance was as of (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balances: list[CashBalanceRecord]
